_comment: Copy this file to specs/{component-name}.json and fill in your component's values. Remove all _comment fields before finalizing.
description: Brief description of what this component does and its role in the design system.
_comment_figmaFileKey: Kiio-Library. 모든 스펙이 이 키를 쓴다 — z6xEkVn88mi5Ai3IHgMrBZ 는 옛 파일이므로 쓰지 않는다.
_comment_figmaNode: 컴포넌트 세트 루트(또는 그 세트들을 담은 섹션)의 node ID. URL 의 node-id 파라미터에서 - 를 : 로 바꾼다. Figma 에 대응물이 없는 컴포넌트는 null 로 두고 그 사실을 여기 적는다(예: Skeleton).

props._comment: Define all component props. Match Figma property names exactly (camelCase). State props (disabled, loading) are boolean, not variants.

variant._comment: Replace with actual variant values from Figma.

loading.description: Shows spinner, hides content, disables interaction.

iconLeading._comment: Leading icon slot. Component handles sizing internally via size variant.

asChild.description: Radix Slot — renders child element with component styles.

variants._comment: Styling per variant value. Use sys tokens only (not ref tokens, not hex values). See CLAUDE.md Token Mapping Reference.

size._comment: Height, padding, typography, gap, icon size, border-radius per size. Values must match Figma exactly.

variant._comment: Visual style per variant. background, text, border using sys tokens.

states._comment: Interactive states. Use sys tokens. State overlays: sys-state-on-dim-* (dark bg) or sys-state-on-bright-* (light bg).

focused.all: border-2 border-sys-primary-300 on state overlay (focus-visible only)

disabled._comment: Color changes per variant when disabled.

loading.description: Content becomes opacity-0 (never visibility:hidden — that removes it from the accessibility tree and the button loses its accessible name); spinner centered inside an aria-hidden wrapper. Component size preserved. Interaction blocked by the capture-phase click guard (onClickCapture) + aria-disabled + aria-busy; native disabled is NOT set so focus and tab order survive.

a11y._comment: Keyboard and ARIA contract. Agreed here, at spec time — a contract that is not agreed before implementation gets bolted on after it. Fill every field: "N/A - <reason>" is a valid answer, an empty field is not. /behavior-spec fills this block; the cases in src/testing/keyboardContract.test.tsx are derived from it.
a11y.role: tablist | radiogroup | button | … (write 'native: <button>' when the native element already supplies the role)

keyboard.Tab: How focus enters the component and where it goes next.
keyboard.Arrow: Which arrow keys move focus or selection, whether the list loops, and what Home/End do.

a11y.focusVisible: What draws the focus ring — element, token, and whether the UA outline is suppressed.

implementation.stateOverlay: Absolute <span> inside component with group-hover/group-active classes. Root needs 'group relative'.
implementation.loadingStrategy: Content wrapper gets opacity-0 (keeps the accessible name), Spinner absolute centered in an aria-hidden wrapper. Guard, type, disabled, tabIndex and aria come from src/components/Button/inert.ts.
